subject: Intro + demo: GitHub integration & webhook/on-prem questions
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira@codehaven.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 15:02:00 -0400
Subject: Interest after signup — quick demo?

Hi Neha,

We signed up for Redwood yesterday (used the GitHub integration flow) and I wanted to see if we could get a short demo focused on integration mechanics. I'm Samira — lead platform engineer at CodeHaven. Our immediate questions are:

- Will Redwood's GitHub integration support GitHub Enterprise Cloud and self-hosted runners?
- Webhook throughput: we have ~8–12 webhooks/min peak across a few repos — will that be ok without extra capacity?
- OAuth app vs GitHub App: which do you recommend for CI/CD + code scanning integrations?

Prefer a 25–30 minute call. Best windows for our team are Tue/Thu mornings PST next week. Can you share a brief agenda and any prep you'd like from us? I've attached the signup export for context.

Thanks —
Samira Khan
Lead Platform Engineer | CodeHaven
samira@codehaven.com

Attachment: signup-export-20260920.csv

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference>
To: Samira Khan <samira@codehaven.com>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 16:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Interest after signup — quick demo?

Hi Samira — really glad you reached out and glad to see you through the sign-up flow. I can run a concise demo that focuses on the integration surface and onboarding steps. A couple quick clarifying questions so we come prepared: 

1) Are you on GitHub Enterprise Cloud (cloud-hosted) or a self-hosted GitHub Enterprise Server?
2) How many repositories would you initially connect (ballpark)?
3) Do you want us to cover token & permission scopes in detail or focus on the end-to-end developer flow?

Proposed 30-minute slots (PST):
- Tue Sep 28, 9:30–10:00am PST
- Wed Sep 29, 11:00–11:30am PST
- Thu Sep 30, 8:30–9:00am PST

If any of those work I can lock it in and invite the AE and a product/engineering lead. I attached a short pre-demo questionnaire that helps the team scope a tailored agenda — can you fill the 2 questions at the top (repo count + peak webhook rate) if possible?

Agenda (proposed):
- 5m intros & goals
- 10m integration flow (GitHub App vs OAuth + permissions)
- 8m demo: install + webhook configuration + routing
- 5m Q&A + next steps (proof-of-concept plan)

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
SDR — Platform Integrations | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.inference

Attachment: pre-demo-questionnaire.pdf

From: Samira Khan <samira@codehaven.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference>
Cc: Ben Park <ben.park@codehaven.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Interest after signup — quick demo?

Hi Neha — thanks for the quick reply. Answers below: 

- We are on GitHub Enterprise Cloud (not self-hosted).
- Planning to connect 3 repos initially (one monorepo + two service repos).
- Please cover permissions in enough detail for our security engineer to sign off, but prioritize the integration flow during the demo.

Webhook load: roughly 10/min at peak. We also want to discuss linking Redwood outputs to our code-scanning pipeline (CodeHaven's internal scanners) — is that something you can demo or at least outline?

The Thu Sep 30 8:30–9:00am PST slot works for us. Attached a simple architecture sketch to show where we expect Redwood to sit.

Thanks,
Samira

Attachment: architecture-diagram.png

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference>
To: Samira Khan <samira@codehaven.com>
Cc: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.inference>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2026 12:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Interest after signup — quick demo?

Great — Thu Sep 30, 8:30–9:00am PST is confirmed and I have sent a calendar invite. Looping in Vivek (AE) and Marissa (Product Engineer) to cover pricing/edge cases and the integration demo respectively.

Pre-call ask: could you grant a read-only billing/org snapshot or paste user counts if available? That helps Vivek prepare the right guidance around Dedicated vs hosted tiers. Also, if you have a sample GitHub app permission matrix or the names of the CI services you use, Marissa can prep a short mapping slide.

I'll attach a short agenda doc and the docs link below so you can skim ahead: https://redwood.inference/docs/github-integration

If anything changes on your side please let me know. Looking forward to the call.

Best,
Neha

Attachment: demo-agenda.docx
Related: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-8721

From: vivek_kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.inference>
To: Samira Khan <samira@codehaven.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.inference>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference>
Date: Thu, 23 Sep 2026 14:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Intro + demo: GitHub integration & webhook/on-prem questions

Hi Samira — Vivek here from the AEs at Redwood. Thanks for confirming the slot. I will cover commercial options briefly (hosted vs Dedicated capacity) and outline what procurement would need for a pilot (SLA, estimated token usage, data retention). If you have a procurement contact, feel free to add them to the invite — otherwise we can do a follow-up.

Quick note: with ~10 webhooks/min and 3 repos, hosted should be fine to start. If you expect sustained spikes (100+ webhook events/min), we can discuss pre-warming Dedicated pools.

See you Thu — I put the calendar invite on my side as well.

Cheers,
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.inference

See you then —
Samira
